#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-10;

inline bool same(double x, double y) { return fabs(x - y) < eps; }

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator<(const Point &t) const {
        if (!same(x, t.x)) return x < t.x;
        return y < t.y;
    }
    Point operator+(const Point &t) const { return {x + t.x, y + t.y}; }
    Point operator-(const Point &t) const { return {x - t.x, y - t.y}; }
    Point operator*(const double &t) const { return {x * t, y * t}; }
    double operator*(const Point &t) const { return x * t.y - y * t.x; } // 叉积
    double operator^(const Point &t) const { return x * t.x + y * t.y; } // 点积
};

struct Line {
    Point s, v; // 起点 + 方向向量
};

// ---------- 几何工具 ----------
Point rotate(const Point &p) { return {-p.y, p.x}; } // 旋转90度

Point inter(const Line &l1, const Line &l2) {
    Point t1 = l1.s + l1.v;
    double s1 = l2.v * (l1.s - l2.s);
    double s2 = (t1 - l2.s) * l2.v;
    double t = s1 / (s1 + s2);
    return l1.s + l1.v * t;
}

double area(const Point &a, const Point &b, const Point &c) {
    return fabs((a - b) * (a - c)) / 2.0;
}

double polygonArea(const vector<Point> &pol) {
    double res = 0;
    int m = pol.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        res += pol[i] * pol[(i + 1) % m];
    return fabs(res) / 2.0;
}
// -----------------------------

// ========== 凸包模板 ==========
struct ConvexHull {
    static vector<Point> build(vector<Point> pts) {
        int n = pts.size();
        if (n <= 1) return pts;
        sort(pts.begin(), pts.end());
        vector<Point> stk(n * 2);
        int top = 0;
        // 下凸壳
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (top > 1 && (pts[i] - stk[top - 2]) * (stk[top - 1] - stk[top - 2]) < eps)
                top--;
            stk[top++] = pts[i];
        }
        // 上凸壳
        int limit = top;
        for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (top > limit && (pts[i] - stk[top - 2]) * (stk[top - 1] - stk[top - 2]) < eps)
                top--;
            stk[top++] = pts[i];
        }
        // 去掉末尾重复的起点
        stk.resize(top - 1);
        return stk; // 逆时针，首尾不重复
    }
};
// =============================

// ========== 最小矩形覆盖模板 ==========
struct MinAreaRect {
    double area;
    vector<Point> vert; // 逆时针，从最下最左开始

    MinAreaRect(const vector<Point> &convex) {
        int m = convex.size();
        if (m < 3) {
            area = 0;
            vert = convex;
            return;
        }

        // 旋转卡壳
        auto val = [&](int i, int j, int k) -> double {
            return fabs((convex[i] - convex[j]) * (convex[i] - convex[k]));
        };
        auto update = [&](const Line &l1, const Line &l2, const Line &l3, const Line &l4) {
            vector<Point> b = {inter(l1, l2), inter(l2, l3), inter(l3, l4), inter(l4, l1)};
            double now = polygonArea(b);
            if (now < area - eps) {
                area = now;
                vert = b;
            }
        };
        auto getline = [&](const Line &l1, const Point &p2, const Point &p3, const Point &p4) {
            Point _v = rotate(l1.v);
            Line l2 = {p2, _v};
            Line l3 = {p3, l1.v};
            Line l4 = {p4, _v};
            update(l1, l2, l3, l4);
        };

        area = 1e18;
        int j = 1, x = 1, y = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int nxt_i = (i + 1) % m;
            // 最远点 j
            while (val(i, nxt_i, (j + 1) % m) > val(i, nxt_i, j))
                j = (j + 1) % m;
            y = max(y, j);
            // 左侧切点 x
            while (x != j && ((convex[nxt_i] - convex[i]) ^ (convex[(x + 1) % m] - convex[x])) > -eps)
                x = (x + 1) % m;
            // 右侧切点 y
            while (y != i && ((convex[nxt_i] - convex[i]) ^ (convex[(y + 1) % m] - convex[y])) < eps)
                y = (y + 1) % m;
            // 构造矩形
            Line l1 = {convex[i], convex[nxt_i] - convex[i]};
            getline(l1, convex[x], convex[j], convex[y]);
        }

        // 将顶点调整为逆时针，并从最下最左开始输出
        if (polygonArea(vert) < 0) reverse(vert.begin(), vert.end());
        int pos = min_element(vert.begin(), vert.end(),
                              [](const Point &a, const Point &b) {
                                  if (!same(a.y, b.y)) return a.y < b.y;
                                  return a.x < b.x;
                              }) - vert.begin();
        rotate(vert.begin(), vert.begin() + pos, vert.end());
    }
};
// =====================================

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    vector<Point> pts(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        scanf("%lf%lf", &pts[i].x, &pts[i].y);
    auto hull = ConvexHull::build(pts);          // 凸包
    MinAreaRect rect(hull);                      // 最小矩形
    printf("%.5lf\n", rect.area);
	for (auto it = rect.vert.rbegin(); it != rect.vert.rend(); ++it)
		printf("%.5lf %.5lf\n", it->x, it->y);
    return 0;
}
